integrity: The infinite-resource and continuity conclusions are proved analytically. The explicit lower bound uses strict rational inequalities; finite numerical quadrature is supplementary. Authorship, independent audit, and external scientific certification are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only the linear invasion boundary at the predator-free equilibrium is classified. Exactly two threshold roots, global attractors, and biological abundance scales are not established. The positive high-resource limit of linear feeding follows from a strictly nonzero newborn fecundity weight under finite smooth maturation; it does not imply literal neonatal reproduction.
title: High-resource predator-invasion limits and reentrant invasion under smooth maturation
